clue.text: Criticism from the pulpit, annoying after drink allowed

let means allowed

explanation.surface: A preacher lambasts the congregation from the pulpit, made all the more irritating because drinking has been permitted.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads the pieces back to front: the drink and the allowance come first, the annoying part follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Bible-thumping is aggressive, ranting preaching, the sort of censure a fiery evangelist delivers from the pulpit.
